tier_descriptions.core: Your archetype. Defines your baseline approach to problems and sets your primary affinity.
tier_descriptions.sub: Your specialization. Adds variety and balance by introducing a secondary affinity expression.
tier_descriptions.cross: Your evolution. The core+sub identity collapses into a single cross class at level 14 (auto-derived).
tier_descriptions.mastery: Your capstone. At level 21 your cross becomes mastery and gains one ultimate with no affinity.

core_skills.E1: Basic attack skill. Must share affinity with core class.
core_skills.E2: Basic buff skill. Must share affinity with core class. Should protect against the core's weak matchup.

sub_skills.E3: Sub skill whose affinity is neutral against the sub affinity.
sub_skills.E4: Sub skill whose affinity is weak against the sub affinity.

cross_skills.E5: Cross skill with neutral affinity (relative to dominant expression).
cross_skills.E6: Cross skill with strong affinity (relative to dominant expression).

Rebel.description: Disgruntled citizen looking to make some changes

Acolyte.description: An augment seeking induction into the ranks of the Church of the Ascension

Hacker.description: A systems specialist who gets off on the fact no doors are going to hold their secrets long if they want to peek inside

Merc.description: A freelance Rebel fighter for hire. Set out for fame and fortune

Specialist.description: A highly specialized Rebel fighter who has settled into a niche slot on a team of Rebel insurgents

Recruit.description: A prospect rebel for an unnamed insurgency ring that has been recruited for special assignments

Convert.description: An Acolyte that has been initiated into the technocracy's Church of Ascension

Priest.description: A lifelong member of the Church of Ascension who has progressed through the ranks to achieve the title of a Priest

Parishioner.description: A valuable preferential member of the flock of the Church of Ascension

Insurgent.description: A specialized tech support agent for the local insurgency.

Zealot.description: An extremely passionate Hacker who is more extremist than insurgent. Has their own agenda although will partner up if it aligns with the current goals

Cipher.description: An encryption expert who works for the bureaucracy. A "good guy" by their own estimation and would be considered an ethical hacker.

Soldier of Fortune.description: A famous well paid eagerly sought after mercenary rebel

False Prophet.description: An apostate priest from the church of ascension who has been branded a false prophet by the leadership

Sleeper Cell.description: A Rebel/Recruit who has now earned enough trust and progressed far enough in their training to become a Sleeper Cell

The Un-made.description: A disillusioned rebel warrior turned acolyte for the Church of Ascension. Rejected duty, excommunicated, doomed to wander without the church’s benefits.

True Believer.description: A senior faithful member of the Church of Ascension who has risen into trusted rank.

Cyber Heretic.description: A hacker turned acolyte who later fell out with the church and is now branded a heretic with a bounty.

Hacktivist.description: A political and bold hacker drawn to rallies, protests, and occasional destruction of corporate property.

Null Apostle.description: A high-ranking church operator isolated from the flock to covertly surveil and enforce leadership will.

Cryptocrat.description: A hacker recruited by the "9" cartel overlords—being groomed for a hidden AI-led power structure.
